title: Literacy Untangled - Videos
description:
I think my child has dyslexia, where do I start? We just got the dyslexia diagnosis, what do we do next? 

These are some of the big questions that ex-special educator turned dyslexia interventionist, Jennie Sjursen, digs into on the Literacy Untangled Podcast. 

Jennie's specialties: breaking down the complexities of dyslexia into everyday language, strategies, and action steps. Think of this as your one-stop dyslexia shop. If it'll help you find a way to support your child through their dyslexia/neurodiverse journey, we'll dig into it! Let's get started!
